# Determinant Systems

> Determinant Systems is an enterprise AI engineering firm that designs and
> builds governed agents, retrieval systems, enterprise search, knowledge
> graphs, workflow automation, and custom AI applications for organizations
> where auditability is a purchasing requirement.

Determinant Systems is the company behind LACE (https://laceplatform.com), the
AI platform for the governed enterprise.

## Company

- [Home](https://determinantsystems.com/): Enterprise AI consulting and engineering.
- [About](https://determinantsystems.com/about): Who we are and how we work.
- [Services](https://determinantsystems.com/services): Engagement types and engineering practice areas.
- [Contact](https://determinantsystems.com/contact): Reach the team.

## Product

- [LACE](https://laceplatform.com): The AI platform for the governed enterprise — permissions-aware enterprise search, an evidence-locked bitemporal knowledge graph, policy-governed AI agents across every channel, and an app builder. Deploys to managed cloud, private VPC, on-premises, or fully air-gapped environments with no external AI calls.
- [LACE documentation](https://laceplatform.com/docs): Platform and `lace-app-sdk` developer documentation.
